setup: Current preview CN/variable; each case independently begins Clear. Build output 123, caret between 1/2 via Home then ArrowRight; input N08 to form active n. Tap one listed top editor control. It must refuse and preserve raw/document/caret/selection-off. Cancel removes n; digit 9 exposes original caret, yielding 1923. Do not pick candidates, Space or Enter.
Clear; digits 123; selection OFF; modifiers unlit
Home then ArrowRight: caret between 1 and 2
N08: raw n, local output 123 with original caret unchanged
verification: observe raw n still present; selection remains OFF
cases.actual: 按组合保护及取消后1923验证步骤反馈正常，未逐项转录
